visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with braided pigtails stands in shallow water on a sandy beach during the golden hour. Her hands are visibly covered in dark, wet sand. In the background, another young girl lies prone in the shallow tide, enjoying the water. The setting is a popular beach with a dense crowd of people and a distant line of trees under warm, late-afternoon sunlight. (2) The camera focuses on the girl as she looks down at the water, anticipating the next wave to wash her hands. She wears a brown t-shirt and light-colored shorts. The background remains filled with tourists and beachgoers, creating a lively leisure atmosphere. (3) The girl reaches down as a wave rolls in, successfully dipping her sandy hands into the foamy water. The camera captures her focused facial expression and hand movements as she rubs the sand away. The background lighting is consistently warm and directional. (4) The girl stands back up and points toward the horizon with a worried expression, talking to someone off-camera. Waves continue to wash around her feet, and the camera maintains a medium shot, documenting her interaction with the beach environment and the people around her.
